promise: Leave a spark, not a job.
intended_audience: Any visitor, including people who only want to suggest an improvement and walk away.
durable_source_vs_ui: One source object may have many temporary projections; no presentation creates an effect.

views.name: Float
views.headline: One light thought can change a world.
views.description: A quiet, floating suggestion next to a hypothetical interface. No joining a team.
views.caption: CoFloat+ candidate: a lightweight, dismissible UX projection.
views.sample: Make the 'Start' button understandable without instructions.

views.name: Sketch
views.headline: See an alternative in one glance.
views.description: A before-and-after sketch of a fictional product decision. Neither side is a deployed UI.
views.caption: CoInstaBuild+ companion: compare a mockup, not a release.
views.sample: Replace the setup form with one playful example.

views.name: Circle
views.headline: Let the question belong to many people.
views.description: Three fictional viewpoints show how a future community might challenge and improve one idea. No actual participants.
views.caption: GroupBuild+ / CoFed+ thought experiment; not a real federation.
views.sample: Let people leave feedback without being asked to volunteer.

lifecycle.meaning: Text exists only in this page; no recipient and no guarantee after closing.
Visitor explicitly stored one draft in local browser storage, no server receipt or independent backup.
Visitor explicitly requested a private download; receipt means request, not external pickup.
Visitor may leave at any time with no duty; unsaved text has no persistence claim.
Future state only, requiring opt-in license, privacy checks, actual receiver and proof.
Future receiver-origin proof; never inferred from a local export or click.

candidate_terms.meaning: Leave without obligations while any explicitly kept source remains addressable

candidate_terms.label: CoFed+
candidate_terms.meaning: Optional federated stewardship of volunteered ideas, not an automatic transfer
